subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

A vivacous and attractive blonde, Mary had no shortage of male admirers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vivacous"** is incorrectly spelt and should be **"vivacious"**. "Vivacous" does not have a meaning in English. (यह शब्द गलत वर्तनी है और इसका कोई अर्थ नहीं है।)

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is a vivacous girl. Correct: She is a vivacious girl.
 
 
 
• **"Vivacious"** means attractively lively and animated. (जीवंत)
 
 
• **Example:** Her** vivacious** personality makes her the life of the party.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is: ** vivacious**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Admirers** (प्रशंसक): People who have a particular regard for someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She has many admirers because of her talent.
 
 
 
• **Attractive** (आकर्षक): Pleasing or appealing to the senses.
 
 
• **Example:** The shop had many attractive items on display.
 
 
 
• **Shortage** (कमी): A state or situation in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a shortage of water during the summer.
